_nota: Short narrado de David y Goliat (1 Samuel 17). Goliat siempre igual: giant Philistine warrior, bronze helmet, bronze scale armor, thick black beard, huge spear.
g01-ejercito: an ancient Israelite army standing on a hill, soldiers with round shields looking down in fear, seen from behind, a vast valley below, dark storm clouds
g02-goliat: a giant Philistine warrior, bronze helmet, bronze scale armor, thick black beard, holding a huge spear, standing alone in a valley, low angle view from the ground making him look enormous, tiny soldiers far behind him
g03-grito: a giant Philistine warrior with bronze helmet and thick black beard shouting a challenge with his arms open, standing in front of an army in a dusty valley, dramatic sunlight
g04-miedo: ancient soldiers hiding behind their shields in a camp of tents, scared faces in shadow, campfire smoke, dusk
g05-pastor: a young shepherd boy walking into an ancient army camp carrying a basket of bread and cheese, tents and soldiers around, warm afternoon light, seen from behind
g06-david: silhouette of a young shepherd with a staff on a hill at sunset, sheep grazing around him, golden sky
g07-piedras: close up of a young hand picking five smooth round stones from a clear shallow stream, sunlight sparkling on the water
g08-burla: a giant Philistine warrior with bronze helmet and thick black beard laughing arrogantly, looking down, dust swirling, harsh sunlight
g09-honda: a young shepherd running across a valley swinging a leather sling over his head, a giant armored warrior far ahead, motion blur, dust
g10-cae: a giant warrior in bronze armor falling face down into the dust of a valley, a huge spear dropping, dust cloud, dramatic light rays
